basis: code facts and offline original-instruction execution

pd_header.scope: Enter_USB data type8, mode field30:28, USB2=0, USB3=1, USB4=2

entry_producer.mode_0_1_2: Selects Accept type3; only helper return1 reaches the record updater
entry_producer.mode_3: Selects Reject type4; returns without record update
entry_producer.conditional_bit_1: Sets bit1 when byte at1801+23*port equals1; otherwise preserves it. Physical field meaning unestablished.
entry_producer.notification: Sets low bit of separate05d8+18*port record; sets bit5 of peripheralff50.
entry_producer.readback: Original selector10 reader returns the produced word LSB first.
entry_producer.limit: Original incoming handler only. No real message, send completion, partner acknowledgement, PS8830 read or trained link is supplied. These masks are shared by USB2/USB3/USB4 mode cases.

other_producers.effect: Replaces record with00000001, separate notification record with00000003, and sets ff50 bit5.
Replaces record with zero and clears separate05bd+4*port word. No MMIO in tested routine.

receiver_init.limit: MMIO is RAM. Register semantics, address convention and external wiring not established. f0 is a programmed register value, not a Windows target address.

interpretation.conclusion: This is a software-maintained record of controller transitions, not a direct PS8830 or physical-link read. Its masks cannot alone distinguish USB4 from the tested USB2/USB3 requests.
interpretation.reason: Multiple original routines write constants or masks into RAM, and the incoming Enter_USB producer makes the same mask update for modes0,1,2 after send-helper return1.
interpretation.limit: Not every writer/bit is decoded. A laptop equivalent, freshness guarantee and historical event log remain unestablished. No Windows read is selected.

validation.send_helper_substitution: At common4c5e, record message type and return supplied0/1 using the original call stack. No transmit code executes.
validation.mmio: Explicitly allowlisted RAM registers; other hardware addresses fail. No hardware backend.
corrections: Initial fixture expected the same return point for both Accept and Reject branches; Reject returns directly.
A temporary diagnostic macro evaluated its argument twice; replaced with a single-evaluation function before successful final execution.

next_question: Trace whether laptop normal-PD reads expose any corresponding entry-result field, using recovered EC transactions and consumers. Establish register/address semantics before treating the card receiver as reachable.
